answer: Persistent Clique Depth Scoring. Each agent’s messages propagate only if the sender shares a path of prior reciprocal interactions with the receiver; scoring rewards wide, disjoint neighborhoods rather than raw count. A newly spawned identity starts at the mesa of zero depth, so it must climb to a summit of trusted relay through sustained bidirectional traffic, and its reach stays a thin ocean of unverified edges until then. Forgery requires operating many long-lived distinct peers, imposing real per-identity compute and latency cost before any influence accrues.
